package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for mapping_logic_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated field mapping blocks across multiple handlers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type ProductRecord struct {
	ID       int
	Title    string
	Price    float64
	InStock  bool
}

type ProductDTO struct {
	ID        int     `json:"id"`
	Name      string  `json:"name"`
	Cost      float64 `json:"cost"`
	Available bool    `json:"available"`
}

func ListProductsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	rows := []ProductRecord{{ID: 1, Title: "Widget", Price: 9.99, InStock: true}}
	var resp []ProductDTO
	for _, p := range rows {
		resp = append(resp, ProductDTO{
			ID: p.ID, Name: p.Title, Cost: p.Price, Available: p.InStock,
		})
	}
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

func GetProductHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	record := ProductRecord{ID: 2, Title: "Gadget", Price: 19.99, InStock: false}
	dto := ProductDTO{
		ID: record.ID, Name: record.Title, Cost: record.Price, Available: record.InStock,
	}
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(dto)
}
